source.title: Finance (Covid-19 and Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2021 s.6

provisions.heading: Amendment of section 46 of Act of 2010
provisions.relevanceReason: Amends VATCA 2010 s.46; cited by the s.46 rate rules (vatcaRevisedCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt:
6.
Section 46 of the Act of 2010 is amended in subsection (1)(cb) by the substitution of “31 August 2022” for “31 December 2021”.
